response.rationale: The customer explicitly states the item is not broken or damaged; it was simply the wrong size ordered. Despite the "defective" flag being true in the facts, the substantive facts show no defect, so the defective-item rule (RET-020) does not apply on the true state. With final_sale == False and days_since_delivery == 35 (> 30), the standard window has expired, making the return ineligible under RET-008. No goodwill grant or fraud hold is present.
